d.ko: Build and explore in a true space sandbox survival adventure. Construct mighty capital vessels, sprawling planetary settlements, and vast space stations in your galactic journey to discover the mysteries of Empyrion!
d.en: Build and explore in a true space sandbox survival adventure. Construct mighty capital vessels, sprawling planetary settlements, and vast space stations in your galactic journey to discover the mysteries of Empyrion!
d.zh: 帝国霸业-银河生存是一款3D开放世界、太空生存及冒险的游戏，而且你可以无缝穿梭于宇宙空间和星球表面。建造，探索，与陌生星球上的各种隐藏的危险战斗，并生存下去。
